title: Chapter 594 - 594 Master; Immortal Technique! (2)
content:
Chapter 594 - 594 Master; Immortal Technique! (2)

Chapter 594 - 594 Master; Immortal Technique! (2)

594 Master; Immortal Technique! (2)

“Qing City is a good place. It raised my master, Lin Fan, and my grandfather, grandmother, and aunt. I’m willing to invest 100 billion yuan in Qing City.”

When they heard the first half of the sentence, the foreheads of Lin Tao, Dai Weixue, and Lin Xiaoyao creased again.

When they heard the second half of the sentence, their hearts skipped a beat.

100 billion yuan investment?

Who was this simple-looking foreigner in front of them?

“Thank you,” Zhao Jiaqi said excitedly. “I thank you on behalf of all the citizens of Qing City. Thank you, Gilbeven gamily!”

Dean Gilbeven waved his hand. “No need to thank me. If you want to thank someone, thank my master, Lin Fan.”

“Yes, yes, yes. Thank you, Lin Fan! Thank you, Lin Fan!” Zhao Jiaqi said.

He was absolutely sincere in saying thank you.

Firstly, a few months ago, Lin Fan had already pulled in many big projects for Qing City, including the airport.

Secondly, Lin Fan solved a few math problems and invented the earthquake prediction device, carbon-based photolithographic machine, super batteries, artificial limbs, and controllable nuclear fusion. He had also won four Nobel Prizes.

Thirdly, Lin Fan was Hua Nation’s hope, Hua Nation’s hero!

And now, because of Lin Fan, Qing City was going to receive 100 billion from Bai Nation’s Gilbeven family!

How could he not thank him?

At this moment, Lin Xiaoyao could not help but say, “Uhh… What does your family do? Is it very profitable?”

Dean Gilbeven immediately put on a humble smile and said, “My family owns an oil company, a few hotels, a supermarket, and a few real estate companies in Bai Nation. We can earn tens of billions of yuan a year.”

Lin Xiaoyao’s mouth immediately turned into an ‘O’ shape.

…

Naturally, Lin Fan did not know that he had caused a small commotion in reality after saving a foreigner.

Of course, even if he knew, he probably would not care.

100 billion yuan investment… In the eyes of others, that may be a lot.

Earning tens of billions every year was even more unimaginable.

However, 100 billion was nothing to Lin Fan.

The money that Lin Fan was earning every month was probably more than tens of billions.

At this moment, Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, and Sam were moving forward in the wilderness.

The sun slowly set, exerting all its strength to release its last rays of light.

Lin Fan looked at the forest not far away and said, “Let’s rest there today.”

“Yes, Master!” Sam replied.

Lin Fan shook his head.

He had told him many times not to call him Master.

However, Sam continued to call him that.

Now, Lin Fan could not be bothered to correct him.

After a while, they arrived under a big tree.

Sam quickly opened his empty backpack and took out a can of beef. “Master, please eat.”

Seeing this…

Lin Fan nodded in his heart.

One had to know that they were not on Earth now, but in a desolate and uninhabited foreign world.

Lin Fan did not lack food.

However, for Sam, a can of beef was definitely the most precious thing on him.

This could save lives!

However, Lin Fan did not say anything.

The Heavenly Hound did not make any noise either. It lowered its head and walked into the distance.

It did not take long for a giant rabbit to be brought back.

Lin Fan took out a knife and started to cut.

The Heavenly Hound was very familiar with the process, and it brought over a bunch of dead wood from afar.

Seeing this…

Sam was stunned.

If he had not brought a lot of compressed biscuits and canned food, Sam would have already starved to death.

He had also thought of capturing rabbits and birds from the Otherworld to eat meat.

However, he had never succeeded.

What was the situation now?

An animal that looked like a dog or a wolf had actually brought back a one-meter-tall rabbit.

Moreover, he was still eating firewood?

This…

It was hard to understand. Was he dreaming again?

At this moment, Lin Fan said, “Do you want to eat meat later?”

Sam nodded reflexively.

Lin Fan said, “Then let’s go with the Heavenly Hound and get some firewood.”

“Oh, oh… Alright,” Sam said.

Although the Heavenly Hound was powerful, its size was not suitable for picking up firewood.

Sam was the exact opposite.

Helping each other in pairs could have a miraculous effect.

Soon, a large pile of firewood was placed beside the big tree.

Lin Fan skewered the meat and smeared all sorts of seasonings on it.

“Fire!” Lin Fan said.

The Heavenly Hound spat out a ball of flames, and the withered branches immediately burst into flames.

Seeing this…

Sam’s eyes widened in shock.

The Heavenly Hound… could spit fire?

However, his shock did not last for long before he was attracted by the rich fragrance of meat.

Sam’s saliva involuntarily flowed down the corner of his mouth.

How long?

How long had it been since he last smelled this fragrance?

Lin Fan looked at the golden skin and said, “It’s almost done.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he gave the Heavenly Hound a large piece of meat.

The Heavenly Hound did not hold back at all. It immediately began to eat heartily, its tail wagging non-stop.

Then, Lin Fan tore another piece of meat and handed it to Sam. “Eat.”

Sam swallowed his saliva and said excitedly, “Thank you, Master.”

Then, he could not wait any longer and stuffed the meat into his mouth.

Lin Fan looked at the Heavenly Hound and then at Sam. He smiled and shook his head.

With two people eating beside him, it seemed that it was easy to affect his appetite.

Today, Lin Fan ate more than usual.

After eating his fill, Sam’s face was filled with satisfaction.

Then, he took out a woolen blanket from his bag and handed it to Lin Fan. “Master, here’s your blanket.”

Lin Fan nodded his head.

However, he still waved his hand and said, “Use it yourself.”

As soon as he finished speaking, his mind moved slightly.

Two sleeping bags appeared in front of him. “Use this sleeping bag at night.”

Seeing this…

Sam was stunned again.

A sleeping bag?

He had been with Lin Fan the whole time and was very sure that Lin Fan did not have a big backpack.

He did not even have a small backpack, let alone a big one.

Where did these two sleeping bags come from?

Then, Sam seemed to have thought of something and said excitedly, “Master, is this Hua Nation’s immortal technique? Is that right?

“Hua Nation’s immortal technique!”

As he spoke, Sam stood up and started dancing again.

Lin Fan’s lips twitched.

He respected his master and had a good heart.

Unfortunately, his brain was not very good.

Lin Fan shook his head. He got up and prepared to draw a circle around him as his sleeping spot.

However, just as Lin Fan took two steps…

A clear notification rang out in his mind.

[Ding! You’ve taken 300,000 steps in the Otherworld. You’ve obtained the Eye of Disaster Luck.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s expression changed slightly as he placed his attention on the Eye of Disaster Luck.

[Eye of Disaster Luck: You can see the disaster or luck of the other party. Black, purple, gray, white, yellow, red, and gold represent the level of the other party’s disaster and luck. Among them, black is the disaster of death, and gold is the luck of miracles. You can easily see the other party’s disasters and luck, and you can display even more charm.]

Instantly, Lin Fan felt his eyes go cold. It was a very comfortable feeling.

Then, Lin Fan raised his head and looked at Sam who was beside him. He saw that there was a ball of red light above his head.

It seemed like… the other party’s luck was pretty good in the future.

Then, Lin Fan looked at the Heavenly Hound that was lying on the ground. He also saw a red glow on its head.

It seemed like… the Heavenly Hound’s luck was pretty good too.

The Eye of Disaster Luck was not a bad ability.

Lin Fan’s lips curled up, and his mood became even better.

Then, he drew a circle of about 200 square meters around him.

[Skill: Draw a Circle as Your Home!]

Instantly, the cool breeze in the mountain forest at night and the noisy cries of beasts in the distance disappeared without a trace.

Sam had not been sleeping well recently.

Firstly, it was because the place was empty and cold.

Secondly, it was because of the noise.

At this moment, all these unfavorable factors disappeared?

“I’m not cold anymore!” Sam said excitedly.

“There’s no noise!

“It’s so comfortable!”

He quickly attributed this strange change to Lin Fan and said excitedly, “Master, it’s you. You used an immortal technique again, right?

“Master, you’re amazing!”

Thus, Sam started dancing again.
